text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick flag — payroll ran for June and I spotted a problem for Alex Rivera. He was converted to FT on Jun 10 in BambooHR but his Jun 1-15 pay was processed as a contractor rate (no withholding, no benefits deductions). Can payroll / finance triage?
Jorge (Payroll): Ugh. Do we have the employee ID and the paystub?
Maya (People Ops): Employee ID 48291. Paystub snippet from payroll export attached below: 
```
Pay period: 06/01 - 06/15
Name: Alex Rivera (48291)
Gross: $4,000.00
Tax withheld: $0.00
Net: $4,000.00
Pay code: CONTRACTOR_RATE
Benefits deductions: $0.00
```
Sam (HRIS): I can confirm conversion record exists — status changed to "Active - FT" on 2024-06-10 at 09:14. Looks like the worker type flag didn't sync to Payroll on the batch job run on 06/12.
Jorge (Payroll): Ok that explains it. We need to: 1) run an off-cycle to withhold employee taxes for the FT portion (6/10-6/15), 2) calculate employer taxes/ER contributions, 3) retroactively deduct benefits premiums or invoice if needed, and 4) prepare to issue a W-2c for the year if withholdings change materially.
Anika (Finance): I'll need the exact withholding amounts to book accruals. Jorge, can you give me the delta (taxes withheld vs should-have-been) and the ER side numbers by EOD?
Jorge (Payroll): On it. Quick sanity calc: estimate federal+state ~22% employee + 8% ER taxes on the mispaid $4k. I'll run precise with the tax engine.
Priya (Benefits): For benefits — Alex enrolled during FT onboarding on 06/11. Enrollment effective 07/01 per plan rules, but premiums should have started from 06/10 if we apply retro coverage for June. We need to decide whether to collect ~$320 premium retroactively or absorb for one pay period. Payroll, can you separate benefit premium lines?
Chris (Manager): I prefer the company absorb the one-pay-period premium to avoid surprise deductions for Alex. He already pinged me confused.
Anika (Finance): If we absorb, we still need to record ER benefit expense. Fine with absorbing for one period; finance will book the cost once Jorge provides numbers.
Sam (HRIS): I'll re-run the worker-type sync job and push a manual update to payroll for Alex so this doesn't repeat. Also filing a change log.
Jorge (Payroll): Steps I will take: 
- Add manual pay adjustment for 06/12 off-cycle: withhold employee taxes for the full $4k and post employer taxes.
- Add benefit deduction line (if decision is to collect) or ER benefit expense line (if absorbing).
- Mark original contractor pay as corrected and attach note: "Converted to FT 2024-06-10 — retro correction".
- Create payroll ticket and request W-2c assessment after year-end (or sooner if needed).
payroll-bot: New internal ticket created: PR-2024-3228 (Alex Rivera retro correction).
Jorge (Payroll): PR-2024-3228 created. I'll run calculations now and post the detailed breakdown here in ~30m.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks. Two asks: 1) Please CC me on PR-2024-3228, 2) keep Alex in the loop — prefer short note rather than big email. I'll message him privately.
Priya (Benefits): One more: if we absorb premiums, HRIS needs to set a note so benefits reconciliation matches payroll. Sam can you add that note?
Sam (HRIS): Yep — adding note and a follow-up task to validate the sync job. Also scheduling a full sync retry.
Anika (Finance): Once Jorge posts numbers, I will confirm GL codes and whether we need any tax filings adjustments (state-level).
Chris (Manager): Appreciate the fast reaction. Please confirm before the off-cycle so I can give Alex a heads up.
Jorge (Payroll): Will confirm the off-cycle amount before posting. Posting ETA 16:30 PT.
Maya (People Ops): Perfect — thanks everyone.
(After 27m)
Jorge (Payroll): Breakdown: 
- Employee tax delta: $880.00 (federal+state+fica)
- Employer tax (ER FICA + FUTA/State): $320.00
- Retro benefits premium (employee share): $0.00 (company absorbing)
- Net owed to company / adjustment: employer will absorb $320 benefit cost + $320 ER taxes = $640 ER expense.
Anika (Finance): Got it. I'll book accruals: debit Payroll Expense $1,200 (tax + benefits ER), credit Accounts Payable PR-2024-3228.
Jorge (Payroll): Off-cycle queued; will not deduct anything from Alex's net (per Chris). Posting now and will attach corrected paystub to ticket.
payroll-bot: Off-cycle posted for employee 48291; reference PR-2024-3228; timestamp 1716100036.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — can someone draft a short note for Alex: "We corrected a misclassification that led to temporary contractor pay; we've posted a correction and premiums will be absorbed by Redwood. You'll see updated paystub in self-service." I'll send it once you approve.
Chris (Manager): Approved.
Priya (Benefits): Note added in HRIS for reconciliation.
Sam (HRIS): Sync verified. Root cause: worker-type flag not included in the 06/12 sync payload. Engineering alerted to fix mapping.
Maya (People Ops): Closing loop — Alex notified by DM, ticket updated. If anything else pops up I'll reopen. Thanks team.
